senses.gloss:
ध (धः) 1.
m. Brahmā; Kuvera;
virtue.
n. Wealth, property.

धा (लि, ञ, डु) दधाति, ते 3.
c. To hold
or support; to nurture; to have.
With अभि to cover, to address;
with अव to take heed; with आ^1 to
receive; with उप^2 to uphold, to per-
form; with नि^3 to hold up, to place;
with परि^4 to put on cloths; with प्र^5 to be
chief, to send; with वि^6 act correctly,
to select; with सं^7 to place. With अनु
and सं to search after; with अभि^8 and
सं to overcome; with उप^9 and आ to
support or prop up; with प्र^10 and नि
to hold up, to elevate; with प्रति^11 and
वि to perform; with वि^12 and अव to
conceal; with सं^13 and आ to instruct;
with सं and नि to place or have over;
with सं and प्र to doubt, to discuss.
